description: Give your agent disposable, receive-only email addresses to test the messages your application sends. Create test addresses with fictional identities and optional form values, then wait for verification codes, sign-in links, invitations or password-reset links. Inspect email authentication checks such as SPF, DKIM and DMARC, identify localhost links and stated expiry information, and diagnose what reached an address when delivery fails. Manage test addresses, reusable test-account checkouts and run notes, and finish a test run with a Markdown report. MCP results do not return the email body, reducing exposure to untrusted sender content, and the service does not open links, preserving single-use links for your test. Connect through OAuth and select one project; no API key is required. Addresses last up to 30 days, subject to account limits. Marketing and offer checks require the relevant Labs features and project settings. In mainland China, use email sign-in rather than Google sign-in; access may be slower.
description_cn: 为 Agent 提供只收信的一次性测试邮箱，用于验证自有或已获授权应用的注册、登录、邀请和密码重置邮件。可创建带虚构身份及可选表单值的测试地址，等待验证码或操作链接；检查 SPF、DKIM、DMARC、localhost 链接和邮件中注明的有效期，并在邮件未到达时排查收件情况。还支持管理测试地址、借还测试账号、记录测试过程并生成 Markdown 报告。MCP 不返回邮件正文，减少不可信发件内容的暴露；服务不会打开链接，便于继续验证一次性链接。通过 OAuth 登录并选择一个项目，无需 API Key；地址最长保留 30 天，使用受账号额度限制。营销与优惠检查需开启相应 Labs 功能和项目设置。中国大陆建议使用邮箱登录，Google 登录不可用，访问速度可能较慢。

en-US: Create a test email address for sign-up testing.
Count the emails a test address has received.
Wait for a test address's verification code.
zh-CN: 创建一个用于注册测试的测试邮箱地址。
统计测试地址收到的邮件数量。
等待测试地址收取的验证码。
